title: Vertex Anthropic: custom headers remove the authentication
body:
### Description

In the VertexAnthropic wrapper, passing custom headers completely remove the authentication from the headers:

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/e5deeaea50f93a09cfc1b6037feab205043e249c/packages/google-vertex/src/anthropic/google-vertex-anthropic-provider-node.ts#L22-L35

I wanted to opened a PR but I'm not sure of the recommended way of doing this. Without this `Resolvable` abstraction I would have done this:

```ts
(async () => ({ 
         Authorization: `Bearer ${await generateAuthToken( 
           options.googleAuthOptions, 
         )}`, 
         ...options.headers
       }))
```

But with the `Resolvable` I'm not sure of the best way, we could either:
1. expose generateAuthToken from this SDK so the caller will have to add this Authorization themself
2. call `resolve` on `options.headers` and then create a new `Resolvable` from the result (with the spreaded headers), but I have the feeling that calling `resolve` should be done "at the edge" as it might have side effects.

I can implement the fix once we decided about the correct fix

### Code example

```ts
const vertexAnthropic = createVertexAnthropic({
  project: "GCP_PROJECT",
  location: "GCP_REGION" ,
  headers: {
    "anthropic-beta": "token-efficient-tools-2025-02-19",
  }
})
```

This will fail with 401 because the other headers are removed
